name: Self-order product card
describe: Menu item button: bordered card with image (h-24 mobile, h-32 tablet, h-40 landscape, h-48 portrait), name (font-medium), rate (muted) and an "In cart: N" primary badge; rounded-lg on mobile, xl/2xl on kiosks. Unavailable items are opacity-50 with a destructive reason in place of the badge.

Use inside the menu grid. Currency is a typed slot: the source prints the raw server string, the kit uses a formatted currency. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
